Text: God, every year we find ourselves entering the night of Your incarnation. Here, You joyfully renew our hope in salvation. [t] We welcome with joy the presence of Your only Son. He took on flesh and comes to redeem us. [*] On the day that He returns to judge creation, allow us to look upon Him without fear. Fill us instead with love from Him
Changes: 2025-12-25 - Paul Prins: First translation of this prayer.
